key_decisions: SHIP ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING — wrapper before image. A new curated image running the OLD stable wrapper would re-install VideoHelperSuite's opencv-python at connect and partially undo the cv2 unification. The reverse is safe: the new wrapper on the CURRENT image finds opencv already baked and ffmpeg on PATH, so promoting it early cannot break a released user.

The wrapper half was far smaller than the previous handoff assumed. install_command and pip_pins are set ONLY on installRequirements:true deps, and those are BAKED (remoteModels._isImageResident) and never volume-installed — so both branches of _install_node_requirements were ALREADY unreachable on the remote path. Of the 7 code-only volume nodes fetched at their pinned commits, exactly ONE ships a requirements.txt: VideoHelperSuite (opencv-python, imageio-ffmpeg). That single line is what the live Pod has been running, and it is a second cv2 build.

Dropping VideoHelperSuite's requirements is safe and was checked at the pinned commit: videohelpersuite/utils.py lines 64-92 wrap the imageio_ffmpeg import in try/except and fall back to shutil.which('ffmpeg'), which the image apt-installs. The LOCAL engine has never installed VHS's requirements either, so this converges rather than diverges.

install_command / pip_pins are ACCEPTED AND IGNORED by the new wrapper rather than rejected, because routes/remoteModels.js:412-417 in every released app still sends them. Deleting the app-side passthrough is the LAST step, after the Pod ships — not before.

Kept in the Dockerfile deliberately: PIP_CONSTRAINT (=/opt/constraints.txt), PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL (the cu130 pin is a LOCAL version that exists only on the pytorch index — MPI-342), the MPI-244 post-node +cu130 re-assert, and the MPI-341 IMPORT FAILED grep. The kornia 'pad' assert survived the deletion of its pin and a cv2/ximgproc assert joined it.

Phase 1 closed as superseded rather than built: runPipCommand has exactly ONE local call site left and it runs --no-deps against a file containing no torch, so a constraint file cannot change any outcome. The only unconstrained pip left is comfy-cli's own during `comfy install`, already guarded on macOS and moot on Windows.
